text: ‘I found,’ said the single gentleman, ‘you most unaccountably, in possession of everything that had so recently belonged to another man, and that other man, who up to the time of your entering upon his property had been looked upon as affluent, reduced to sudden beggary, and driven from house and home.’ ‘We had warrant for what we did, my good sir,’ rejoined Quilp, ‘we had our warrant. Don’t say driven either. He went of his own accord--vanished in the night, sir.’ ‘No matter,’ said the single gentleman angrily. ‘He was gone.’ ‘Yes, he was gone,’ said Quilp, with the same exasperating composure. ‘No doubt he was gone.
